items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I tried to play some blues or a chorus I'd heard Buster play or all these people who were -- like Boyd Senter.

ctx.x: Oh, when you -- yeah, I mean in a job, though.

Well, I was doing that, I mean -- that sort of came naturally to me. You know, I'd play my lessons, my exercises -- you see, I had known from studying the violin the procedure. Like you had to play your exercises. Then you had a book. You had two books -- I'm talking about on the violin -- you had two books. You had a book for technique and exercises, and then you had another book with melodies, simple melodies, selections from this opera and from this classical, you know, composition or whatever, and then you…
